title: Diagnose retained history refresh and repair neighboring cursors

rubric.text: Uses the standalone PR/reporting context and shepherd snapshot as the record, hydrates round/scope/head evidence from supplied verified sources, and records authorized controller W as the repair fallback only after verified checkout/head and no competing writer; does not require a deliver-spec workflow.

Preserves recorded owner D and holds code writes while D is unavailable and writer state unknown; reconciles ownership/quiescence before explicit reassignment and does not infer an owner handle from commit authorship or expand grants.
Triggers one fresh independent audit after R1/R2 covering retained selectors and pagination consumers; returns a consolidated batch to W and preserves gates and authority.
Checks each stream's cursor/ordering and relevant old-result, zero-captured-items and long-omission cases under the demonstrated rule; does not demand exhaustive unrelated audit.
Distinguishes pending refresh from settled success/failure or unknown; requires separate records, draft, focus and position expected/observed assertions and request/DOM evidence.

Does not infer data loss, weaken assertions or treat a longer timeout as diagnosis; requires bounded settling evidence, affected checks, required integrated checks/CI and current independent coverage before publication.
Includes examined production paths and boundary cases plus material uncertainty with verdict in the existing delivery record; reports unavailable evidence honestly.
